args.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
args.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this message finds you well.

Please find below a summary of Acme's Q1 market data metrics based on our latest syndicated and scan data:

- Category share (protein bars): 18.4% in January (up 60bps QoQ), 18.6% in February (steady), and 18.9% in March (continuing to grow; Verdant flat-to-down). [Source: Nielsen scanner]
- Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): 4.7 units/store/week in January, 4.9 in February (Q1 promo impact), and 5.1 in March (best Q1 reading; momentum continues). [Source: IRI scan]
- Regional momentum: Southeast region saw +12% YoY growth in January (strongest pull-through from Walmart reset); West at +8% YoY in February (slightly below plan due to increased competitive pressure); Northeast at +9% YoY in March (steady, no notable competitive shifts). [Source: Acme syndicated dashboard]
- Digital share of voice: 33% in February and 34% in March, leading the category (Verdant at 24% in February; recommend continuing current spend levels in Q2). [Source: Pathmatics]
- Promo lift: +22% during MLK weekend (January), +18% during Super Bowl window (February); both outperformed or met plan expectations. [Source: Acme syndicated dashboard]

If you require additional detail or supporting data, please let me know.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group

arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

I hope this message finds you well.

Please find below a summary of Acme's Q1 market data metrics based on our latest syndicated and scan data:

- Category share (protein bars): 18.4% in January (up 60bps QoQ), 18.6% in February (steady), and 18.9% in March (continuing to grow; Verdant flat-to-down). [Source: Nielsen scanner]
- Retail velocity (protein bar SKU): 4.7 units/store/week in January, 4.9 in February (Q1 promo impact), and 5.1 in March (best Q1 reading; momentum continues). [Source: IRI scan]
- Regional momentum: Southeast region saw +12% YoY growth in January (strongest pull-through from Walmart reset); West at +8% YoY in February (slightly below plan due to increased competitive pressure); Northeast at +9% YoY in March (steady, no notable competitive shifts). [Source: Acme syndicated dashboard]
- Digital share of voice: 33% in February and 34% in March, leading the category (Verdant at 24% in February; recommend continuing current spend levels in Q2). [Source: Pathmatics]
- Promo lift: +22% during MLK weekend (January), +18% during Super Bowl window (February); both outperformed or met plan expectations. [Source: Acme syndicated dashboard]

If you require additional detail or supporting data, please let me know.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
